_comment: scrape.py --sources sources.example.json. Built 2026-10-17 from each source's robots.txt, feeds and terms (see SOURCES.md). The terms decide the method, not what is technically reachable. 'none' = never requested; turn one on only with a licence or written permission, or after reading the terms yourself. Hosts not listed keep the command-line defaults.

x.com.access: robots.txt Disallow: / for all bots; ToS bans scraping without written consent. Use the X API v2 (developer account + bearer token, pay-per-use).

www.nseindia.com.access: Terms bar systematic/automated collection; scripted requests stall with no response. Licensed route: NSE Data & Analytics corporate data feed.

www.bseindia.com.access: Static RSS (data/xml/announcements.xml, notices.xml) is served to scripts, max-age=60. Terms unverified (reproduction reportedly prohibited). The .aspx feeds, api.bseindia.com and the AttachLive filing PDFs (503/406 on 17 Oct 2026) block scripts: do not use.

api.bseindia.com.access: Akamai blocks scripted clients (403, robots.txt included); undocumented API.

www.moneycontrol.com.access: User Agreement 4.4(iii) bars bots, scrapers, spiders and crawlers. No public API or licence programme found.

economictimes.indiatimes.com.access: RSS is for personal, non-commercial use; site terms bar systematic downloading, building databases and automated summarisation for real-time outputs. Licence: Times Syndication Service.

www.livemint.com.access: Terms 7A: no robots/spiders/crawlers except search engines; covers RSS and APIs.

www.business-standard.com.access: robots.txt and terms return Akamai 403 to scripts; terms (via search) restrict reuse.

www.reuters.com.access: robots.txt: automated collection prohibited without prior written consent. Licensed: Reuters Connect API / LSEG.

www.cnbctv18.com.access: Network18 terms: no scraping, crawling, mining or machine-readable use without written permission.

www.financialexpress.com.access: Terms: personal, non-commercial licence; no database building or automated extraction (covers RSS).

www.ndtvprofit.com.access: Akamai 403 to scripts on every path incl. robots.txt; terms could not be read.

feeds.feedburner.com.access: NDTV Profit's public Feedburner feed (ndtvprofit-latest). NDTV Profit's terms are unverified: headlines for your own signals only; article pages are blocked anyway.

www.thehindubusinessline.com.access: RSS is for personal and non-commercial use (THG terms). Headlines for your own trading only: not for a competition entry, redistribution or ML training without a licence. robots.txt blocks named AI crawlers.

api.gdeltproject.org.access: GDELT: free, unrestricted use with citation. DOC API asks for 1 request / 5 s and answered our first request 429 twice (16-17 Oct 2026). 15-minute batches: a confirmation source, never first-to-know.
